RECORD CORRECTION — the #1336 reference implementation branch name was wrong in the epm:clarify v1 marker on this task, and in plan v1/v2 §2 + §12 A9.

Wrong (as recorded): scripts/issue1336_pooled_split.py lives on branch issue-1336.
Right (verified this turn): the file does NOT exist on issue-1336 or origin/issue-1336 (git cat-file -e returns non-zero on both). It lives on issue-1336-fullcorpora / origin/issue-1336-fullcorpora, checked out at .claude/worktrees/issue-1336-fullcorpora/scripts/issue1336_pooled_split.py (41,185 B).

The downstream conclusion the wrong name supported is UNCHANGED and still correct: the file is not on main, so the acceptance-criterion-4 fixture must be a self-contained reproduction rather than a path reference. What the wrong name DID cost is that the real code was never opened during planning — which is how the fixture-fidelity defect below got in.

Structures read directly from the real file this turn:
- Shape 1 (embed_prompts, lines 541-560): "if smoke:" early-exit returning a hash-based toy vector. The statements AFTER the If are model = _load_sentence_transformer(revision) [LOWERCASE callee], logger.info(...), model.encode(...), return. There is NO import and NO capitalized-callee call after the If — the production import "from sentence_transformers import SentenceTransformer" sits inside the helper _load_sentence_transformer (line 531), a DIFFERENT function. The only import in the region is "import numpy as np" INSIDE the toy branch (line 547).
- Shape 2 (assert_split, lines 703-790): NO early exit at all. It is the per-check if/else form — "if smoke: logger.info(...) else: raise AssertionError(...)" — repeated per assertion. Its docstring cites the gotchas.md smoke/production-parity GATE-CALIBRATION rule, i.e. the downgrade was RULE-SANCTIONED, not non-compliance.

Consequence for the plan: §12 A10 ("Both incident shapes are early-exit forms ... covered by the §4.10(B) early-exit rule") is false on BOTH shapes, and the §4.11 fixture rewrites shape 1 into the one form the early-exit heuristic does catch. That is folded into the plan v3 revise round.
